title: still present since round 3: Vacancy/status mutations return Ok unconditionally - nonexistent ids report success; the Result error channel is dead
detail: Re-verified on the r4 tree: the list.map no-ops when the vacancy id matches nothing, yet Ok(vacancy_id)/Ok(slug) is returned. Callers cannot distinguish a miss from a mutation; the Result channel is dead.
recommended_fix: Check the match after the map and return Error on miss, or drop the Result and simplify the call chain.

title: still present since round 3: mark_opened doc claims an idempotent Submitted->UnderReview transition but applies it to any status
detail: change_status (demo_store.gleam:1308) still transitions unconditionally - no guard that the current status is Submitted. Idempotency rests entirely on the dispatch layer's open_dispatched set.
recommended_fix: Transition only when the current status is Submitted; otherwise leave the store unchanged.

title: still present since round 3: create_vacancy derives the id from an 8-char-truncated name slug with no uniqueness check
detail: Two demo-created vacancies whose property names share an 8-char cleaned prefix get the same id (and the same RTDEMO short_code) - the second silently shadows the first in store lookups.
recommended_fix: Append a disambiguator (sequence or vacancy count) or extend the suffix until unique against existing ids.

title: still present since round 3: send_reminder / remind_applicant / send_bulk_invite mutate nothing and return canned counts that contradict the seeded awaiting list
detail: The store now returns the store unchanged with hardcoded counts; demo_api still discards `next` via `let _ = next`. v-maples has 1 remindable row yet reports (2,1); bulk-invite ignores the typed emails and reports a fake invalid address.
recommended_fix: Parse the submitted emails, compute results from the actual awaiting list, and thread the mutation (mark reminded/invited), or drop the fake mutation.

title: Refcheck dispatch arms unpinned: the r3-asked dispatch-level refcheck pins shipped as store-level tests only - reverting fire_demo_refcheck's store threading stays green
detail: The claimed 'refcheck dispatch pins' call demo_store.refcheck_action directly - demo_update's fire_demo_refcheck/fire_demo_refcheck_substitute (store threading, hyphenated wire_action, route guard) and the new UserSavedRefcheckEdit §8.3 validation mirror have zero dispatch-level coverage. 611 client tests pass with the dispatch layer unpinned.
recommended_fix: Add one dispatch-level test per refcheck path: UserChoseRefcheckAction skip/re_enable, UserConfirmedRefcheckAction start/take_over, and UserSavedRefcheckEdit substitute through client.update asserting the store changed.

title: still present since round 3: zero-caller export demo_store.notifications
detail: grep over client/src and client/test finds no caller (only notifications_unread is used). Dead export shipped in the public API of the module.
recommended_fix: Delete the export or wire it.

title: still present since round 3: status_from_slug silently coerces any unknown status slug to Submitted
detail: Typos in demo action wires silently land as Submitted rather than failing loudly; an invalid slug also writes a bogus status audit entry.
recommended_fix: Return a Result (Error on unknown slug) or make the demo store reject unknown slugs.

title: still present since round 3: fetch_leaderboard_page ignores its page parameter
detail: Latent today: demo_store.leaderboard returns all entries with total == length(entries), so the load-more button (leaderboard_view.gleam:676 `loaded_count < total`) never renders in demo. The discarded param would mis-serve any future paged demo fixture.
recommended_fix: Slice by page or drop the parameter and the UserClickedLoadMoreApplications arm.

title: still present since round 3 (reduced): download_timeout still duplicated between client.gleam and demo_update.gleam with diverging signatures
detail: The store_of half of the r3 duplication note is fixed (client.gleam:5919 `demo_store_of` delegates to `demo_update.store_of`). download_timeout remains duplicated: client's takes (analysis_id, delay_ms); demo_update's re-implements it with a hardcoded 90_000.
recommended_fix: Call client.gleam's download_timeout(id, 90_000) from demo_update (or lift both into a shared demo helper module).
